Bundled browser libraries for the SCI website. Files are byte-for-byte copies
from the npm registry tarballs listed below; do not edit them. To update,
download the new tarball, copy the same dist file, and refresh this record.

markdown-it

  source:  https://registry.npmjs.org/markdown-it/-/markdown-it-15.0.3.tgz
           (package/dist/browser/markdown-it.umd.min.js; also
           https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/markdown-it@15.0.3/dist/browser/markdown-it.umd.min.js)
  file:    markdown-it.min.js
  sha256:  391f2aa638e75e6c7859d0a5c5650ef0956722a45998f17e05b83bc655778e1e
  license: MIT (markdown-it.LICENSE, which also carries the licenses of the
           bundled entities, linkify-it, mdurl, punycode.js, and uc.micro)
  tarball sha256: 98a7453983ab0e268c17dbd5260bf7190ba46b4cca912327fc1c1a2578e4b56d

License files:
  markdown-it.LICENSE  sha256: e01e3064c9c163e4b8deb3e167032f40f21443c01de5e5bbb999a5c771498cb1

The minified files end with a sourceMappingURL comment; the .map files are not
bundled, so browser developer tools may report a missing source map. This does
not affect rendering.
